newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds quiet and little changed.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds quiet and little changed.

text.p: Most sectors of the UK meals and feeds market were unchanged on Friday owing to a lack firm leads from Chicago.
"Chicago finished back more or less where it started which didn't give us much to go on," said one broker.
High protein soymeal ex-mill Liverpool was one stg down for all positions expected Jun/Oct which was unchanged.
High pro soymeal on the east coast and Brazilian 48's, rapemeal, corn gluten and sunmeal were all unchanged. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8062
